q2_gaps: support-verb / light-verb construction ("gives an answer to X", "makes a decision", "takes a walk"): the light-verb rule under Time covers only occur / happen / took place over event-nouns, and the instruction set nowhere says whether other support-verb constructions reify the light verb as its own event with the nominal as Theme, or collapse onto the nominal's verb
notes: The parse takes the literal, surface-faithful reading (a give event, "an answer" a witness Theme, "to the tower" a Recipient), which is what the instruction set's general surface-faithfulness doctrine and the Theme/Recipient role tests yield; simple present correctly carries no status atom.
